teennick.us.description: When Henry's dad gets an offer for a new job in Bordertown, Henry and Ray go undercover to try and stop him from getting the job and prevent Henry from having to move. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-09-22

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Massage Chair
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man shows up with a cool new massage chair, Henry, Charlotte and Jasper compete in a series of physical and mental challenges to see who wins the chair. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-07-13

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Birthday
teennick.us.description: While trying to celebrate his birthday, Henry keeps getting interrupted by crimes going on in Swellview. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-11-03

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Balloons of Doom
teennick.us.description: When Dr. Minyak takes the Man Fans hostage, Captain Man and Kid Danger have to find a way to rescue them without Dr. Minyak seeing them move. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-09-30

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Double Date Danger
teennick.us.description: When Miss Shapen's niece comes into town and chooses Jasper over Henry, he discovers that she has much bigger plans in the works. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-02-11

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Trouble With Frittles
teennick.us.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger find themselves in the middle of a debate about Swellview's favorite snack. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-11-05

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Mom
teennick.us.description: When labor pains leave Captain Man helpless, Kid Danger and Piper step up to take on a couple of slick grease thieves. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-11-02

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Escape Room
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man enter an escape room by a factory owner with a "chip" on his shoulder, and become trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-08

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Beginning of the End
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger reveals to Captain Man that he doesn't want to be stuck in Swellview and be his sidekick forever; to make matters worse, Kid Danger is recruited by another town to be their hero. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Phony Valentine
teennick.us.description: When Henry's crush goes on a date with someone else, Schwoz provides an android to make her jealous; Ray has an unpleasant date with one of Henry's teachers. (Children, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2015-02-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Caved In
teennick.us.description: Henry, Charlotte and Ray are trapped inside when Jasper accidentally triggers the emergency lockdown mode for Junk-N-Stuff and the Man Cave. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-02-28

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Dinner With Bigfoot
teennick.us.description: When the gang befriends Bigfoot in the woods, Kid Danger and Captain Man try to help get rid of a pesky hunter that's been trying to capture him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-03-09

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Thunder Van
teennick.us.description: The children sneak into the Thundervan for an unauthorized joyride. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-09-13

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Doubles Trouble
teennick.us.description: Phoebe enlists Max's help in a tennis tournament in order to win a membership at Link's family's country club. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2015-02-26

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Breaking Dad
teennick.us.description: While teaching at Max and Phoebe's school, Hank falls asleep after eating special turkey sandwiches. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2014-06-14

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Save the Past Dance
teennick.us.description: Tired of hearing tales of Hiddenville's legendary mayor, the kids use a time machine to travel back 60 years to disprove the myths; but when they inadvertently alter the past, the effect spells disaster for their hometown. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-11-18

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - All the President's Thunder-Men
teennick.us.description: After their requests drive Kickbutt to quit, Max and Phoebe get what they want when Hank is named the new SuperPresident; being the First Family of the Hero League takes its toll on the family.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Dog Day After-School
teennick.us.description: Billy and Nora seek Phoebe's help to retrieve their mother's tablet after it is confiscated at school.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Who's Your Mommy?
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe accidentally sell one of Barb's old superhero utility belts to an Electress fan at the family's garage sale.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Party All the Crime
teennick.us.description: Chloe's birthday party is cancelled, and Max and Phoebe compete to throw her a new one; when Max's time-stopping birthday gift falls into the wrong hands, he must work with Phoebe to stop some party poopers from ruining Chloe's birthday.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Bummer School
teennick.us.description: Chloe, Jinx and Booch are designing a school mascot, but Max and Phoebe's feud over their jobs ruins the project; Chloe criticizes them, and the twins realize their fighting affects Chloe now that they're guardians.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Leave No Van Behind; Sponsor Tripped
teennick.us.description: When Vanzilla seems too broken down to ever drive again, Lana, Dad and Gramps band together to fix her; Lynn and friends enjoy free perks around Royal Woods when their team gets sponsored by local businesses.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Future Tense; Lynner Takes All
teennick.us.description: After meeting an impressive family, the Loud parents worry that their children are not doing enough to ensure successful futures; tired of Lynn's poor sportsmanship during board games, the siblings decide to team up to take her down.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Out of the Picture; Room With a Feud
teennick.us.description: Afraid they will be forgotten, Lincoln and Clyde want to make a splash in the yearbook and crash group photos; seeing his sisters fight with their roommates, Lincoln suggests a room shuffle based on a compatibility test.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Scoop Snoop; Eye Can't
teennick.us.description: The Action News team struggles to find out how Katherine Mulligan is scooping their news leads; trying to avoid a trip to the eye doctor, Lisa makes a new pair of glasses that actually makes her eyesight worse.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Intern for the Worse; The Old and the Restless
teennick.us.description: When Lincoln and Clyde both get an internship at Flip's, they compete to win the title of manager; after seeing how tame Pop Pop has gotten in his advanced age, Lincoln takes him out for a day to remember.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Director's Rut; Friday Night Fights
teennick.us.description: Luan turns to Mr. Coconuts for help after she struggles to direct her school's play; Lisa joins Lynn's football team as the analytics coach to prove that math will always beat out heart.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Present Tense; Any Given Sundae
teennick.us.description: Convinced that their scrapbook isn't good enough for Dad's birthday, the Loud kids seek out the perfect gift; Lily hears the parents mention ice cream if the kids are good, so she uses baby smarts to avert sibling disasters.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Scales of Justice; Crimes of Fashion
teennick.us.description: Lana springs into action when she learns her favorite fish are in jeopardy of losing their home to construction; when Leni gets fired from her job due to missing scarves, Lincoln and Clyde, as Ace and Jack, take on the case.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Predict Ability; Driving Ambition
teennick.us.description: After discovering he has rituals, Lincoln worries he's predictable and vows to change things up; Lori develops the yips when she finds out that the golf coach from her dream college is coming to see her play.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Exchange of Heart; Community Disservice
teennick.us.description: To divert the attention of his helicopter dads, Clyde arranges for an exchange student to stay with them; Lola takes a timid new classmate under her wing and gives her a social butterfly transformation.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - One of the Boys; A Tattler's Tale
teennick.us.description: Lincoln wishes he had 10 brothers instead of 10 sisters, and Lisa gives him a glimpse into that reality; Lola wants to be a part of the siblings' secrets club, but her siblings are reluctant to let in a tattle tale.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Making the Grade; Vantastic Voyage
teennick.us.description: Lincoln's social standing is at stake when his four-year-old sister is put into his fifth grade class; the children grow tired of their family van falling apart, so they decide to try to trick Dad into buying a cool, new van.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Dine and Bash; Sofa, So Good
teennick.us.description: After failing to make chef Guy Grazer a meal on his show, the kids try to erase the footage before it airs; the kids search all over Royal Woods to find the missing furniture they left outside while cleaning.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loud Cloud; You Auto Know Better
teennick.us.description: Tired of Mom's sticky note system, Lincoln and Lisa create an app to keep track of the family's schedule; Lana creates an auto body shop to try and buy a new bike, but her shop turns corrupt when Flip becomes her mentor.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - No Laughing Matter; No Spoilers
teennick.us.description: When Luan overhears her siblings complaining about her comedy, she decides to give it up; knowing Leni's history of spoiling surprises, the children decide not to tell her about their mother's upcoming party.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Europe Road Trip: A Bite in Transylvania; Greece Is the Word
teennick.us.description: When the Loud's bus gets a flat tire, they're invited to stay the night in a spooky couple's mysterious castle; during a tour of the Parthenon, Lincoln puts on a soldier's helmet which sends him back to Ancient Greece.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - School of Shock; Electshunned
teennick.us.description: Lisa takes over her first-grade classroom and learns that there's more to teaching than just knowing facts; Leni goes toe-to-toe with the mayor in a citywide Royal Woods election.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Change of Heart; Health Kicked
teennick.us.description: Clyde is desperate to learn how to act normal around Lori, so he enlists Leni's help; worried that their parents are hurting their health from not being active, the children encourage them to exercise.

themoviechannel.us.title: Urban Cowboy
themoviechannel.us.description: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. (Drama) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Friend
themoviechannel.us.description: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. (Drama) - 2019

themoviechannel.us.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
themoviechannel.us.description: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. (Comedy drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Proof
themoviechannel.us.description: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
themoviechannel.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Double Jeopardy
themoviechannel.us.description: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Mystery) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Dutchman
themoviechannel.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Every Breath You Take
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family. (Thriller) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: Fatal Attraction
themoviechannel.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: The Faculty
themoviechannel.us.description: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
themoviechannel.us.description: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. (Comedy drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: A Christmas Proposal
themoviechannel.us.description: Hoping to impress his family during a Christmas visit, a hotshot Seattle attorney asks a down-on-her-luck chef to pose as his girlfriend. Their business arrangement soon gets complicated as real sparks begin to fly during the holiday season. (Holiday, Romance) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
themoviechannel.us.description: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. (Romantic comedy) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Moonage Daydream
themoviechannel.us.description: Featuring never-before-seen footage and performances, filmmaker Brett Morgen explores David Bowie's creative, spiritual and musical journey. (Documentary, Music, Rock, Pop) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: Almost Famous
themoviechannel.us.description: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Band Aid
themoviechannel.us.description: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band. (Comedy drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. (Romantic comedy) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Love, Rosie
themoviechannel.us.description: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles. - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
themoviechannel.us.description: An outrageous British woman (Renée Zellweger) decides to take control of her life, but instead falls for two very different men (Colin Firth, Hugh Grant). - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Almost Famous
themoviechannel.us.description: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Doin' It
themoviechannel.us.description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Love and Monsters
themoviechannel.us.description: A young man and his traveling companions battle an array of monsters during an 80-mile journey to find the woman he loves. - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Blue Valentine

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Hidden Fortress
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Japanese peasants Matashichi (Kamatari Fujiwara) and Tahei (Minoru Chiaki) try and fail to make a profit from a tribal war. They find a man and woman whom they believe are simple tribe members hiding in a fortress. Although the peasants don't know that Rokurota (Toshirô Mifune) is a general and Yuki (Misa Uehara) is a princess, the peasants agree to accompany the pair to safety in return for gold. Along the way, the general must prove his expertise in battle while also hiding his identity. (Comedy) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Men Who Tread on the Tiger's Tail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A routed Japanese general, Yoshitsune (Hanshiro Iwai), and his group of loyal retainers are forced to flee from Yoshitsune's own traitorous brother. En route to a safe zone, Yoshitsune and his bodyguards must pass through a heavily garrisoned mountain stronghold held by his brother's forces. Hopelessly outnumbered, Yoshitsune and his guards, led by samurai Benkei (Denjirô Ôkôchi), decided that the safest way to pass through the checkpoint unharmed was to dress themselves as monks. (Drama, Adventure) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Divorce of Lady X
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Trapped in London due to the fog, lawyer Everard Logan (Laurence Olivier) grudgingly allows the use of his hotel sitting room by a stranded partygoer, Leslie Steele (Merle Oberon). Charmed by Leslie even after she tricks him into giving up his bedroom and pajamas, Everard becomes infatuated, despite his suspicion that she is married. When Lord Mere (Ralph Richardson) engages Everard to file for divorce against his wife, who met a man at the hotel, Everard fears he may be the other man. (Comedy) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Woman Wanted
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Just after a jury finds Ann Gray (Maureen O'Sullivan) guilty of murder, the car carrying her to prison crashes into another auto. Ann escapes and ends up in the vehicle of Tony Baxter (Joel McCrea), a lawyer who has eyes for her. Tony realizes Ann is innocent, so he vows to help her prove it, risking his neck in the process. Tony and Ann are pursued by the police and by Smiley Gordon (Louis Calhern), a mob boss who engineered Ann's escape thinking that she can lead him to a $250,000 stash. (Crime drama) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Young Man With Ideas
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Maxwell Webster practices law in Montana, where he lives a staid existence with his wife, Julie, and their kids. He eventually opts for a drastic change and moves his family to California to start over. Studying to pass the state's bar exam, Maxwell endures numerous hardships while trying to make ends meet, even becoming involved in questionable schemes. When he gets into trouble for being associated with a bookie, Maxwell has to use his legal skills to defend himself. (Comedy drama) - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Never the Twain Shall Meet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A San Francisco importer (Leslie Howard) inherits custody of a Polynesian beauty (Conchita Montenegro). (Comedy) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Please Believe Me
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young English woman, Alison Kirbe (Deborah Kerr), inherits a Texas ranch and heads to America to start a new and prosperous life, having no idea of the sort of man trouble she'll attract. A gambler in debt, Terence Keath (Robert Walker), pursues her. But so does another bachelor on the hunt, playboy Jeremy Taylor (Peter Lawford), who is traveling with his lawyer, Matthew Kinston (Mark Stevens), to whom Kirbe is most attracted. Unfortunately for her, he thinks she's running a scam. (Romantic comedy) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Law in Her Hands
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A defense lawyer (Margaret Lindsay) sets her career goals aside to marry a district attorney (Warren Hull). (Romantic comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Just This Once
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Mark MacLene (Peter Lawford) is a millionaire playboy, but he won't be one much longer if he keeps blowing through his inheritance. In an effort to control his spending, Mark's executor, Judge Samuel Coulter (Lewis Stone), hires lawyer Lucy Duncan (Janet Leigh) to watch over Mark. The two are even forced to live together, much to the dismay of Lucy's boyfriend, Tom (Richard Anderson). At first Mark tries to ditch Lucy and her frugal ways, but soon he finds himself falling for her. (Comedy) - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Reformer and the Redhead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Kevin G. Maguire (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Kathleen (June Allyson), work at the local zoo as the superintendent and tour guide, respectively. As such, they believe that all animals should be treated with kindness, which conflicts with the views of a powerful and crooked political boss (Ray Collins). When the boss has Maguire fired due to this difference, Kathleen springs into action by contacting an attorney and mayoral hopeful (Dick Powell) for help in saving her father's job. (Comedy) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Adam's Rib
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A courtroom rivalry finds its way into the household when prosecuting lawyer Adam Bonner (Spencer Tracy) faces off against his wife, Amanda (Katharine Hepburn), who happens to be a defense attorney. Working on opposite sides of a lawsuit where a woman (Judy Holliday) has shot her cheating husband (Tom Ewell), Adam and Amanda are both determined to win the case, and their home becomes the setting for comical showdowns, with neither spouse willing to relent. (Romantic comedy) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Glenn Miller Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Glenn Miller (James Stewart) is a poor trombone player with dreams of fame. Eventually, through years of hard work and determination, he is able to start his own band, and they become one of the most successful groups of the big-band era. With a beautiful wife (June Allyson) and one of the biggest songs in America, "Moonlight Serenade," Miller has it all. But at the onset of World War II, Miller enlists, giving up his fame and success to help entertain the troops stationed in Europe. (Biography) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Growing up in a coal-mining community in Philadelphia, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey (playing themselves) are encouraged by their father, Thomas (Arthur Shields), to study music. The highly competitive siblings are soon playing with their father's band. As grown men, the Dorseys begin touring with their own ensemble, with childhood friend Jane Howard (Janet Blair) on vocals. Despite their rising success, the bickering brothers have a falling out, and Jane schemes to reconcile them. (Musical) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Gene Krupa Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This musical biopic is based on the life of Gene Krupa (Sal Mineo), the famed jazz drummer. His Catholic parents want him to be a priest, but Krupa rebels and moves away to make it as a musician in New York City, along with his friend Eddie (James Darren). He eventually falls for a girl, Ethel (Susan Kohner). But the seductions of other women, drugs and fame -- plus a lack of a formal music education -- put a strain on his personal and professional life, and Krupa must re-examine his goals. (Biography) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cabin in the Sky
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When compulsive gambler Little Joe Jackson (Eddie "Rochester" Anderson) dies in a drunken fight, he awakens in purgatory, where he learns that he will be sent back to Earth for six months to prove that he deserves to be in heaven. He awakens, remembering nothing and struggles to do right by his devout wife, Petunia (Ethel Waters), while an angel known as the General (Kenneth Spencer) and the devil's son, Lucifer Jr. (Rex Ingram), fight for his soul. (Musical) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Reet, Petite and Gone
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: To claim his inheritance a jazzman (Louis Jordan) must find the right kind of woman. (Musical comedy) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hi-De-Ho
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Fast-talking manager Nettie (Ida James) helps legendary jazz bandleader Cab Calloway (Cab Calloway) land a steady gig at the exclusive Brass Hat Club. Upon hearing the good news, Calloway's untrusting girlfriend, Minnie (Jeni Le Gon), mistakenly assumes that he and Nettie are having an affair. As Calloway and his band prepare for their maiden performance at the Brass Hat, the vengeful Minnie asks Boss Mason (George Wiltshire) -- the thuggish owner of a competing club -- to put a hit on her man. (Musical) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mystery Street
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When bargirl Vivian (Jan Sterling) discovers that her married boyfriend has refused to leave his wife, she steals a car and drives to Cape Cod to confront him. Several months later her skeleton washes ashore, and local police officer Peter Moralas (Ricardo Montalban) must work with Harvard forensics expert Dr. McAdoo (Bruce Bennett) in order to piece together the twisted tale and discover who the murderer is before an innocent suspect pays the ultimate price. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bad Day at Black Rock
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When John J. Macreedy (Spencer Tracy), a one-armed war veteran, arrives in the small desert town of Black Rock, he's not greeted warmly. Searching for a man named Komoko, Macreedy is met with disdain by virtually every local, including the resident thug, Hector David (Lee Marvin), and the imposing Reno Smith (Robert Ryan). As Macreedy's investigation deepens, hostility turns to violence -- and to imminent danger for the mysterious and inquisitive stranger. (Crime drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Edge of Doom
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the death of his ailing mother, Martin Lynn (Farley Granger) feels desperately alone. His only concern is that his mother receive an elegant burial. Unfortunately, Martin is also in a dire financial situation and cannot afford an expensive church service. Enraged, Martin viciously directs his frustrations at a clergyman, killing him. The impulsive act leaves Martin in an even more despondent state, though a kindly priest (Dana Andrews) may be able to guide the young man toward redemption. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Witness for the Prosecution
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Seven Days in May
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: U.S. President Jordan Lyman (Fredric March) hopes to bring an end to the Cold War by signing a nuclear disarmament treaty with the Soviets, much to the displeasure of the hawkish General James Scott (Burt Lancaster), Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. When Scott's aide, Martin "Jiggs" Casey (Kirk Douglas) stumbles on shattering evidence that the General is plotting a coup to overthrow Lyman in seven days, "Jiggs" alerts the President, setting off a dangerous race to thwart the takeover. (Thriller) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Swimmer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Well-off ad man Ned Merrill (Burt Lancaster) is visiting a friend when he notices the abundance of backyard pools that populate their upscale suburb. Ned suddenly decides that he'd like to travel the eight miles back to his own home by simply swimming across every pool in town. Soon, Ned's journey becomes harrowing; at each house, he is somehow confronted with a reminder of his romantic, domestic and economic failures, until a final visit with an old flame (Janice Rule) leaves him devastated. (Drama) - 1968

actionmax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Contagion
moremax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Daytrippers
moremax.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Adult Best Friends
moremax.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
moremax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

moremax.us.title: They All Laughed
moremax.us.description: The employees of New York City's Odyssey Detective Agency can't seem to prevent themselves from getting over-involved in their clients' lives. When aging gumshoe John Russo (Ben Gazzara) is assigned to trail an Italian millionaire's wife, Angela (Audrey Hepburn), he inevitably falls for her continental charm. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Romantic comedy) - 1981

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Alto Knights
moremax.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Broken City
moremax.us.description: Former cop Billy Taggart (Mark Wahlberg) sees a chance at redemption for past sins when New York City's Mayor Nicolas Hostetler (Russell Crowe) calls on him for a special job. Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Black Butterfly
moremax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

moremax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
moremax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
moremax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Camp Hell
moremax.us.description: Horrific events plague a teen when his parents send him to a Christian camp. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
moremax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
moremax.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Life of Pi
moremax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Head Office
moremax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Meg
moremax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Friendship
moremax.us.description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor. - 2025

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
moremax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: A record-company employee (Jonah Hill) has just a few days to get a boozy British rock star (Russell Brand) to Hollywood for a big comeback concert. - 2010

moremax.us.title: MacGruber
moremax.us.description: After his sworn enemy steals a nuclear warhead, a clueless soldier-of-fortune (Will Forte) leads a skilled team on a mission to retrieve the device and bring the thief to justice. - 2010

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 A landmark documentary series examining the events and far-reaching repercussions of the two fatal shots fired in 2.6 seconds that ended the life of 19-year-old Kumanjayi Walker.

sbssydney.au.title: Going Places with Ernie Dingo
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E4 Augusta, Eden, Seisia Ernie takes in 360-views of Augusta from an iconic lighthouse, Narelda learns the fascinating history of whaling in Eden and Aaron connects with a Cape York local making an impact in her community.

sbssydney.au.title: Plat Du Tour
sbssydney.au.description: S4 E15 Parmentier Of Braised Oxtail Saint Gervais is nestled at the foot of Mont Blanc. It is loaded with places for hikers and skiers. Guillaume uses local ingredients to make one of his favourite meals, permentier of braised oxtail.

sbssydney.au.title: Plat Du Tour
sbssydney.au.description: S4 E16 Crayfish Risotto Guillaume creates a crayfish and saffron risotto. He co-opts the services of Giles Buissan and Roland Bel, two local fishermen to help him source the main ingredient.

sbssydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbssydney.au.description: S6 E7 Too Hot To Cook What do you make when it's too hot to cook? Adam's very cool guests, actor Bert LaBonte and chef Rodney Dunn, join him to make food that's fast and refreshing.

sbssydney.au.title: The Supervet
sbssydney.au.description: S8 E5 Oz, Ollie And Bayleigh Meet adventurous cat, Oz, who broke his ankle falling. Cassie and Ashley thought their only option was to have the leg amputated, Noel has given them hope that Oz's leg could possibly be saved.

sbssydney.au.title: Jeopardy!
sbssydney.au.description: S42 E178 Episode 178 Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions.

sbssydney.au.title: Letters And Numbers
sbssydney.au.description: S4 E89 Episode 89 Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show.

sbssydney.au.title: Mastermind Australia
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E78 Episode 78 In this round, the specialty subjects are The Love Bug and Herbie rides again, The Office US: Seasons 1-3, Guinea Pigs, and Ace Ventura.

sbssydney.au.title: SBS World News ᴺᵉʷ
sbssydney.au.description: E322 Episode 322 Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbssydney.au.title: Bill Bailey's Korea
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 Seoul II Bill's bird watching at the North Korean border, attending his living funeral, trying the online craze of mukbang, then performing on a rooftop.

skysport8.nz.title: REWIND
skysport8.nz.description: EP05: THEO WALCOTT: MY PREMIER LEAGUE YEARS. At just 16 years old, Theo Walcott attracted the attention of Arsene Wenger, who brought the electric youngster to Arsenal. The Englishman bagged over 100 goals for the Gunners, becoming one of their most proli. (Episode)

skysport8.nz.title: PL STORIES
skysport8.nz.description: EP24: MIKEL ARTETA. We explore Mikel Arteta s impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops playe. (Episode)

skysport8.nz.title: PL STORIES
skysport8.nz.description: EP23: ASTON VILLA 92-93 - BEHIND THE FIRST SEASON. Aston Villa s 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson s Villa, revealing the characters. (Episode)

skysport8.nz.title: PL STORIES
skysport8.nz.description: EP21: MARCUS STEWART - THE FIGHT OF MY LIFE. Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football s toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond t. (Episode)

ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E2 G-Animals Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features Bill Bailey, Sean Lock, Sandi Toksvig, Alan Davies and John Hodgman.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E15 The Real You Finn has to give a speech at Princess Bubblegum's science barbecue and seeks out a quick fix to make himself smarter.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 High Baby Fashion The Bears enter Panda into a fashion contest, but he's got some fierce competition when Madam Malin and Madeline show up!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E40 Royal Jelly Bumblebee offers to help Robin with his leadership skills, by teaching him how to act like a queen bee.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E8 Can't Buy Love When Morbucks falls in love, she finds the first thing money can't buy.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E24 Malediktator When Chloe threatens to leave Paris, Mr Bourgeois gets akumatized into Maledikator. Invested with absolute power, he wants to make his daughter's dreams come true so that she stays with him! Will Ladybug manage to stop him?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E13 The Movie Star Gwen is in trouble when she asks movie star and Miss Grayling's cousin Lily Vernon to the school, while Nancy sets up a prank to avoid eating carrots!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Interview Hannah helps a distracted Chan-Mi prepare for an important interview with a potential Showcase sponsor. Leo struggles to fit into his assigned role in his boy group \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E25 The Gap Behind The Dumpster Atticus decides to start a secret club with Rory, but after Rory invites everyone else to join, Atticus gets cross.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E33 Now That's Flower Power! While May trains for the Pokemon Contest in Slateport City, Torchic's appetite for berries gets her in trouble!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 The Imposters Twitch and Spitfire accidentally swap bodies! Experiencing each other's lives is awkward, and it's hard for both to avoid getting caught behind enemy lines. Especially when Twitch learns the Decepticons plan!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E5 Werepapas When Adrien gets nervous about meeting his grandparents, Marinette gatecrashes the lunch to support him, unaware that a family war is about to break out.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E35 The Petals When Leslie's petals begin falling off he feels like his looks are fading, Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him. The only problem is they know nothing about style or beauty.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E8 Susie and her Sister Chapter 2: Hot Corn Girls On her 15th birthday, Susie must prepare for her Gibbous Rite Ceremony. Will Mildred be able to keep her chaotic magic in check for just one day so Susie can become the full witch woman of her dreams?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E12 The Sub Teacher Cyril teaches a week-long seminar about humans leading up to an exam. For once, Jim is just a regular student and spends the week having fun with Bianca. But he soon realizes he's not as much of a human expert as he thought.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E30 Stay Goth, Poodle Girl, Stay Goth Gwen accidentally brings a pink stuffed pony she loves to daycare and spends the day denying it's hers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Zero Day: Part One Lois meets her journalism idol, Vicki Vale - only for Vicki to make Lois question her loyalty to Superman. Meanwhile, Superman hunts down Task Force X while dealing with a new power!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Journeys ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E3 Ivysaur's Mysterious Tower! As Ash and Goh become accustomed to their new roles as research fellows for Professor Cerise, they find themselves surrounded by Pokemon mystery and wonder!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Hobby Wizz has an exciting new hobby, and he is desperate to keep it a secret from his friends and most importantly, from YOU!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Had Learn to spell and write the word HAD. This series demonstrates some fun ways to learn common words in English. 'Learn a Word' is informed by the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Alphablocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E10 No Fun Without U Uncertain about jumping to the top of the vowels' acrobatic tower, Alphablock U rejects the offer of a crash MAT, a safety NET and new KIT. But, excited to HOP, he goes UP at last.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E23 Déanann go leor Meascáin Donn Brown takes the Colourblocks exploring in the forest. Learn different ways to mix brown with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E23 The Mystery of Fraction Island The Numberblocks are exploring Fraction Island. Why are there four islands, when their map shows one? Will the Fraction Friends they meet help them solve the mystery?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E28 Many More Mr. Mores! Mr. More takes letter m's from all around town and uses them to make many MORE Mr. Mores!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 Handwash Maddie visits a factory where hand wash is made and uses her special camera to see inside a big vat to see the colour being mixed.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E23 Rainbow Connection Why are flowers all different colours? How do different pollinators see colour? The gardeners create beautiful flower bouquets for bees, butterflies and birds.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E8 Fat Dr Chris and Dr Xand look at body fat and show how it keeps you warm in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Horrible Science ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E12 Hexagons, Jelly Walls and Half Life Reality hit Love Flyland launches (pro-tip: don't eat while watching), salty street magic with Luna the Magician, and it's the Blur/nuclear physics mash-up you've been waiting for!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Built to Survive
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Wild Wild Wetlands Phil Breslin ventures into Australia's notorious swamp country where he encounters the speedy freshwater crocodile, the predatory barramundi and the world's largest reptile, the saltwater crocodile.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ages Of Ice Portrait of a Scientist Shorts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Dr Louise Archer Polar Bears International As a child growing up on the coast of Ireland, Dr Louise Archer dreamed of the animals she saw in nature documentaries. Today, the Polar Bears International researcher studies one of the Arctic's most iconic species.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E205 Episode 205 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E6 Vw Camper And A Bomb Shelter A dad in Norfolk renovates a VW van to surprise his camping-mad kids. A couple on the Isle of Wight turn a brick bomb shelter into a bijou bar. Will Hardie checks out a Russian-inspired Grayson Perry creation in Essex.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E5 Old Acquaintance Lee joins Facebook and is contacted by his ex-girlfriend Karen from twenty years ago. As hidden secrets from their past are revealed, a jealous and angry Lucy crashes Lee's dinner date accompanied by her old flame Ben.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E8 Adam is in denial over Fiona's death and Hugo Ross, an old cold-war traitor, is approached by MI5.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E14 Through The Fog Holmes and Watson race to help Detective Bell when he becomes a victim of a bio-terrorism attack at the precinct and the station is quarantined.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E21 Make A Wish Mark returns to work, battered and bruised after the assault. Carla's baby arrives two months prematurely and in critical condition. An ulcer patient refuses to let Carter operate. Doug throws Carol a surprise birthday party.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E4 Citizen Jessica As staff prepare the Cattleman's Ranch to serve as a polling place for the 1996 election, Jessica suspects that one of the restaurant employees may be an undocumented immigrant. Eddie and his friends debate who killed Tupac.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E15 Idleness Tonight the QI panel are giving themselves up to an evening of idleness and indolence, with Ross Noble, Dara O'Briain, Jeremy Clarkson and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E1 Series 5 Episode 1 Rob Brydon hosts with team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack who lead celebrity guests Jack Whitehall, Rebecca Front, Nick Hewer and Miranda Hart.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E2 Episode 2 Adam and Jamie test the action movie cliché of Dumpster Diving. When the hero's cornered on a rooftop, can a leap into a skip below really save you, or is it just Hollywood hype?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 New Malden It's a secret mission to challenge the very best of them as Phil heads to New Malden in Surrey, and a semi-detached family home which has the busy A3 in the front garden.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E7 Floating Home And A Magical Vista A couple creates an ambitious floating home; two siblings build their own mobile homes away from home; George and Will conjure up a magical 30-mile vista in a wall just 20 cm thick.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E33 Episode 33 YolanDa Brown, Rev Kate Bottley, Joel Dommett and John Thomson continue to test their general knowledge skills.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E24 Bob Sedergreen, Beth Hart, Frank Woodley & Cal Wilson Josh, Ella and Adam are joined by Bob Sedergreen, Beth Hart, Frank Woodley and Cal Wilson.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E3 Weaponry Join Sandi Toksvig for a look at some Weaponry with Nish Kumar, Lou Sanders, Roisin Conaty and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E6 Craig Charles, Amy Gledhill, Shazia Mirza & Jeremy Vine Rob Brydon is back as host, with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the lightning-quick team captains. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Craig Charles, Amy Gledhill, Shazia Mirza and Jeremy Vine.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E6 A Mermaid in Pitchfork Pines Drac and his Monster Pets help a mermaid embrace her uniqueness by learning to glide above water.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Mystery on Goblin Island When the team is trapped on an Island with a prank-throwing lighthouse, the team must save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Bob Bilby When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to put down their screens and show him a good time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Flour's Big Day Out While Flower, Penny, and Dirk head out for the day, Flour the cat sneaks off on his own mischievous adventure around the plaza.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E38 The Witch Competition A young witch is planning on moving into Mrs Witch's house. Mrs Witch has to come out of retirement to keep her place in the Little Kingdom.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Looph 2.0 Looph builds a robot to give a science talk but the Piris encourage her to do it herself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E22 Fruit And Veggie Friends Day All the fruit and veggies in the supermarket are enjoying a day to celebrate friendship but Evil Pea is determined to ruin it.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Batwheels
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E19 Redbird-o-flage Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight. But when he needs to use the bat-o-flage and become invisible, he'll have to learn that doing good is its own reward.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E12 Sticky Gecko Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E7 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 7 Kiv's brain rejects his new body and Crozier is forced to rethink his plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E8 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 8 Crozier has selected Peri to be the Kiv's new host body - with devastating results.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E9 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 9 The Doctor suspects Professor Laskey's party of a series of murders.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E10 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 10 The Vervoids begin to attack the crew and passengers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E11 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 11 Bruchner plans to send the Hyperion III into the black hole of Tartarus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E12 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 12 The Doctor realises that if he can speed up the Vervoids life span, they will decay.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E13 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 13 The Valeyard's true identity is revealed and the trial aborted.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E14 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 14 The Valeyard has created a weapon within the Matrix that will destroy the Time Lords.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E1 Time and the Rani: Part 1 A newly regenerated Doctor is taken to the Rani’s base by Urak the Tetrap, while Mel meets some of the Lakertyans – and falls into one of the Rani’s traps.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E2 Time and the Rani: Part 2 The Rani’s impersonation of Mel backfires badly because Urak can't tell the difference, while the Doctor attempts to learn the secret of the Loyhargil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E3 Time and the Rani: Part 3 The furious Rani begins to slaughter the Lakertyans, so Mel rallies the survivors, while the Doctor is readied to donate his mind to the Rani’s grotesque experiment.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E4 Time and the Rani: Part 4 As Mel convinces the Lakertyans fight back, the Tetraps turn on the Rani and the Doctor ensures the missile is deflected away from the asteroid.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E5 Paradise Towers: Part 1 The legendary Paradise Towers is supposed to be the height of luxury but when the Doctor and Mel arrive, they find it is as far from a paradise as possible.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E6 Paradise Towers: Part 2 With the Doctor condemned to death by the caretakers and their bizarre rulebook, Mel faces cannibalistic OAPS. Is Pex going to be the true hero of Paradise Towers?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E7 Paradise Towers: Part 3 Mel and Pex play cat and mouse with the lethal cleaner robots while the Doctor and the surviving Kangs learn all about Kroagnon the Great Architect.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E8 Paradise Towers: Part 4 Kroagnon has been reborn, and is using the Chief Caretaker’s reanimated corpse to move around Paradise Towers. To stop him the Doctor must teach the residents teamwork.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E9 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 1 The Doctor and Mel win a trip to Disneyland in 1959 but after an accident in space, they actually end up in South Wales instead, along with an assassin and his intended victim.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E10 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 2 Gavrok and the Bannermen have arrived on Earth, searching for Delta and slaughter the holidaymakers without compunction to draw her out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E11 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 3 As Billy and Ray do what they can to help save Delta and the baby, the Doctor and Goronwy the beekeeper face Gavrok and his Bannermen one last time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E12 Dragonfire: Part 1 On Iceworld, the Doctor and Mel meet Ace, who has found herself there after a timestorm. While Ace nearly joins Kane’s mercenaries, the Doctor and Glitz explore the ice caverns.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E13 Dragonfire: Part 2 The Doctor and Glitz meet the infamous dragon, which is really a biomechanoid. Meanwhile Kane turns on his allies, as he cannot trust anyone in his search for the dragonfire.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E14 Dragonfire: Part 3 Shown the archive by the biomechanoid, the Doctor discovers that Kane is from the dead world of Proamon. Mel witnesess the destruction of the Nosferatu and Ace faces temptation.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E4 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 4 The streets of East London shake under a civil war being fought between the Daleks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E5 The Happiness Patrol: Part 1 The Happiness Patrol walk the streets of Terra Alpha, destroying all the killjoys, on the orders of the despotic Helen A. And in the Kandy Kitchen, something terrible lurks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E6 The Happiness Patrol: Part 2 The Doctor escapes the Kandyman while Ace meets the Pipe People. Later, fleeing for her life, Ace is captured and selected to audition for the Happiness Patrol.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E7 The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E8 Silver Nemesis: Part 1 A group of Neo-Nazis in South America are seeking the Nemesis Statue – as is a shuttle full of Cybermen and the mysterious Lady Peinforte from the 17th century.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E9 Silver Nemesis: Part 2 The Cybermen have the Nemesis Statue but Lady Peinforte and Richard fight back because they were prepared with gold-tipped arrows and De Flores still has a plan to set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E10 Silver Nemesis: Part 3 The Nemesis Statue is alive, thanks to Lady Peinforte's insanity, and with De Flores's Nazi’s wiped out by the Cybermen, Nemesis claims it has secrets to reveal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E11 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 1 Bellboy and Flowerchild escape the Psychic Circus but are pursued by the Chief Clown. The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to Segonax, some of whom are not what they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E12 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 2 The mysterious family watching the acts within the ring, dissatisfied with Nord, destroy him. Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he’s not the next to displease them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E13 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 3 Ace and Bellboy team up to stop the Chief Clown while the Doctor realises that he is next into the ring. The Captain has another trick up his sleeve and shows Mags's true colours.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E14 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 4 The Gods of Ragnarok are revealed and while waiting for Ace to escape the Chief Clown, the Doctor must entertain them as long as possible in the dimension of the Dark Circus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E14 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 4 The Gods of Ragnarok are revealed and while waiting for Ace to escape the Chief Clown, the Doctor must entertain them as long as possible in the dimension of the Dark Circus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E1 Battlefield: Part 1 As UNIT are transporting a nuclear warhead around Carbury, knights in armour arrive to contine waging a war that began thousands of years ago, but in a wholly different dimension.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E2 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 2 Renegade Daleks battle Imperial Daleks for control of the Hand of Omega.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E3 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 3 The Doctor discovers the difference between the two Dalek factions and why they want a stellar manipulator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E4 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 4 The streets of East London shake under a civil war being fought between the Daleks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E5 The Happiness Patrol: Part 1 The Happiness Patrol walk the streets of Terra Alpha, destroying all the killjoys, on the orders of the despotic Helen A. And in the Kandy Kitchen, something terrible lurks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E6 The Happiness Patrol: Part 2 The Doctor escapes the Kandyman while Ace meets the Pipe People. Later, fleeing for her life, Ace is captured and selected to audition for the Happiness Patrol.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E7 The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon

And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)
