fxm.us.title: Lincoln
fxm.us.description: With the nation embroiled in still another year with the high death count of Civil War, President Abraham Lincoln brings the full measure of his passion, humanity and political skill to what would become his defining legacy: to end the war and permanently abolish slavery through the 13th Amendment. Having great courage, acumen and moral fortitude, Lincoln pushes forward to compel the nation, and those in government who oppose him, to aim toward a greater good for all mankind. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
fxm.us.description: Harriman Nelson (Walter Pidgeon) is the creator of a revolutionary nuclear submarine. After testing its capabilities in the Arctic Ocean, Nelson and the commanding officer (Robert Sterling) surface the vessel, only to discover the sky ablaze. Learning that the Van Allen radiation belt has caught fire, Nelson conceives a plan that could save the planet from destruction, but the U.N. shoots it down. Nelson is convinced it will work, but an onboard psychiatrist (Joan Fontaine) questions his sanity. (Science fiction) - 1961

fxm.us.title: Witchcraft
fxm.us.description: For generations, the Whitlocks and the Laniers have been feuding, including when Vanessa Whitlock (Yvette Rees), accused of being a witch, was buried alive centuries ago. Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Innocents
fxm.us.description: Based on the Henry James story "The Turn of the Screw," a psychological thriller about a woman who takes a governess job for two orphans in a Victorian home. She begins to see what she believes are ghosts and suspects the children's bizarre behavior is the result of supernatural powers. (Horror) - 1961

fxm.us.title: Hush... Hush, Sweet Charlotte
fxm.us.description: Forty years ago, on the night they were meant to elope, Charlotte Hollis (Bette Davis) found her lover decapitated during a party, the blood on her dress leading everyone to suspect she was the murderer. Now, in 1964, Charlotte is an old recluse and must fight to keep her home. She enlists the help of her cousin Velma (Olivia de Havilland), who was there at the time of the murder. However, soon after Velma's arrival, Charlotte's mind becomes unstable, and she starts seeing her dead lover's head. (Horror) - 1965

fxm.us.title: Enemy Mine
fxm.us.description: During a war between humans and the reptilian Drac race, spaceship pilot Willis Davidge ends up stranded on an alien world, along with enemy fighter Jeriba Shigan. While both Willis and his Drac counterpart can breathe on the planet, the environment and its creatures are relatively hostile, forcing the two to work together to survive. As time goes by, Willis and Jeriba become unlikely friends, though their unique relationship faces considerable challenges. (Science fiction) - 1985

fxm.us.title: Ready or Not
fxm.us.description: Grace couldn't be happier after she marries the man of her dreams at his family's luxurious estate. There's just one catch -- she must now hide from midnight until dawn while her new in-laws hunt her down with guns, crossbows and other weapons. As Grace desperately tries to survive the night, she soon finds a way to turn the tables on her not-so-lovable relatives. (Horror, Thriller, Dark comedy) - 2019

fxm.us.title: The Empty Man
fxm.us.description: A series of mysterious disappearances in a small Midwestern town may be linked to a supernatural entity. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
fxm.us.description: Welcome to Raccoon City, once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corp. The company's exodus left the city a wasteland, a dying town with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, a group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night. (Horror, Action) - 2021

fxm.us.description: A woman's quiet life on an American farm takes a terrifying turn when the remains of her estranged mother arrive from Korea. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Cocoon
fxm.us.description: Oscar-winning fantasy in which the residents of a Florida rest home get a new lease of life when they stumble across an alien "fountain of youth" in a disused holiday home. Unbeknown to them, aliens have been using the swimming pool in the house to store their cocooned brethren, giving the waters a powerful, rejuvenating quality. (Fantasy) - 1985

fxm.us.title: Nightmare Alley
fxm.us.description: Roustabout Stanton Carlisle joins a traveling carny and unsuccessfully schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband, Pete. But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel. (Crime drama) - 1947

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: The Detective
fxm.us.description: When a gay man is viciously slain, Detective Joe Leland (Frank Sinatra) is put on the case. Joe eventually tracks down the victim's roommate, who confesses to the crime and is sentenced to death; however, the outcome of the case doesn't sit well with the detective. Norma (Jacqueline Bisset), a distraught widow, visits Joe. She believes her husband's death was no accident, but the cops don't seem to care. Joe begins to investigate, and stumbles on a cover-up related to his previous case. (Crime drama, LGBTQ) - 1968

fxm.us.title: The French Connection
fxm.us.description: New York Detective Popeye Doyle (Gene Hackman) and his partner (Roy Scheider) chase a French heroin smuggler. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: The French Dispatch
fxm.us.description: A love letter to journalists set in an outpost of an American newspaper in a fictional 20th-century French city that brings to life a collection of stories published in "The French Dispatch." (Comedy drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Missing
fxm.us.description: When her mother disappears in Colombia, June's search for answers is hindered by international red tape. Stuck thousands of miles away in Los Angeles, June uses all the latest technology at her fingertips to try and find her before it's too late. - 2023

fxm.us.description: Invited by her long-lost family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, a woman is thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity. - 2022

documentary+.us.title: Hung up on a Dream: The Zombies Documentary

documentary+.us.description: In the Kettle River Range of Northeastern Wash., wolves are being killed to protect livestock that graze on public lands; a lone range rider, Daniel Curry, works year-round using non-lethal mitigation methods to help save wolves.

documentary+.us.description: School of Fish offers an intimate portrait inside one family's seasonal salmon rituals and their connection to the Bristol Bay Fly-Fishing and Guide Academy, where local youth are empowered through fly-fishing to serve as guides and conservationists.

documentary+.us.title: The Last Blockbuster
documentary+.us.description: The manager of the last Blockbuster video store struggles to keep the store open.

documentary+.us.title: Mahale Chimp Guardians

documentary+.us.title: 40 Watts From Nowhere
documentary+.us.description: Frustrated by what she was hearing on commercial radio, Sue Carpenter built a 40-watt FM station in 1995 and ran it out of her apartment in Los Angeles, exploiting a legal case that allowed hundreds of low-power radio operators to proliferate.

documentary+.us.title: Charm Circle

documentary+.us.title: Seeding Change: The Power of Conscious Commerce
documentary+.us.description: Consumers are empowered to purchase from "triple bottom line" businesses that consider the social, environmental and financial impacts of their companies and address some of today's most challenging issues.

documentary+.us.title: Here's to Life: The Story of The Refreshments

His partner, Bristol, is still at large. Alvin wants only to get out of prison and start fresh with his girlfriend, Lisa, and when the Feds, led by U.S. Treasury investigator Clenteen, set him loose on a sketchy deal, he thinks his luck has changed. Alvin has his freedom and the Feds have found their bait. (Action, Comedy) - 2000

365blk.us.title: Queen of the Damned
365blk.us.description: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat. (Horror) - 2002

365blk.us.title: Freedom Song

Will expects his son to follow suit, but their relationship is put to the test when Owen starts joining in peaceful protests organized by the Student Non-Violent Coordinating Committee. (Drama) - 2000

But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other. (Comedy drama) - 2008

5starmax.us.title: Rodan
5starmax.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms. (Science fiction) - 1957

5starmax.us.title: Hop
5starmax.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Hobbit

5starmax.us.title: Fantastic Planet
5starmax.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
5starmax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Contagion
5starmax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Scanners
5starmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
5starmax.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (Science fiction) - 1974

5starmax.us.title: Walkabout
5starmax.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Scream
5starmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Flashpoint
5starmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
5starmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). bbcearth.us.description: The Lost Elephants of Timbuktu In the heart of the Sahara Desert, a herd of elephants emerges from behind a wind-swept sand dune.

bbcearth.us.title: Craft in America
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Memory History of the craft movement; some of the best craft artists in America.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Snow Leopard: Beyond the Myth Nisar Malik spends two years documenting the daily life of the snow leopard, the most elusive of all cats.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Jaguars: Brazil's Super Cats South America's supreme predator, jaguars are also one of the most elusive animals on the planet; a pioneering team in Brazil tracks individual wild jaguars to gain amazing insight into their lives.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Himalayas A documentary looking at the variety of wild animals inhabiting the Himalayas.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Badgers: Secrets of the Sett While badgers are easily recognized, remarkably few people have ever seen one alive; it's a creature blamed for destruction and disease, but surprisingly little is known about the sett society.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Echo Ely and Friends - Africa's Forgotten Elephants This film goes beyond events at the Amboseli National Park, in search of elephants living in Africa's vast landscape.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Florida: America's Animal Paradise Florida is famous for its beaches, blue water and year-round sun, but it also has a surprising wild side; it is home to pine forests, coral reefs and the famous Everglades wetland, the largest subtropical wilderness in the U.S.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Last Grizzly of Paradise Valley Wildlife filmmaker Jeff Turner finds the Cascade Mountains under threat, especially its last grizzly bears.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Meerkats: Secrets of an Animal Superstar David Attenborough tells the story behind the world's most famous meerkat family.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nisha's family helps her cook chicken dhansak and a Hungarian favorite.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nisha cooks chicken korma and marinated tandoori monkfish tail on the BBQ.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein searches for herring along the northeast coast of Scotland.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Pilchards, bream, ormer and cockles with laverbread.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Sweet brown shrimp; flounder; fresh salmon; oysters; scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Silver eels; edible seaweed; langoustines; pollan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Cockles and samphire; pink shrimps; Cromer crabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Wild smoked salmon; sea trout; sea moss pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Fresh cod; smoked kippers; prepares halibut with cucumber; salmon en croute.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Cambodia and Vietnam Rick enjoys freshly caught swimmer crabs cooked with green peppercorns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Vietnam and Thailand Rick Stein travels down the Mekong River to Vietnam.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

Tension continues to build, leading to an extremely violent confrontation. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2011-09-16

cinevault.us.title: Takers
cinevault.us.description: Gordon Jennings (Idris Elba) and his friends enjoy a luxurious lifestyle funded by bank robberies, and they avoid capture by sticking to a strict set of rules. As they celebrate the latest job, a former associate arrives with a daring plan to rob an armored car. The lure of so much cash is too tempting to resist but, unbeknown to Gordon's men, this heist puts them on a collision course with Russian mobsters and a detective (Matt Dillon) who will do anything to capture them. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-08-27

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Cockpit Failure
circlecountry.us.description: Minutes before they're scheduled to land in Zurich, the pilots of a routine passenger flight can't find the runway; they abort and power up the engines in order to climb, but they are too late. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-12

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - The Heathrow Enigma
circlecountry.us.description: British Airways' flight number 38 suffers from double engine failure and crashes near Heathrow in 2008. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-07

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Scandinavian Airlines 751
circlecountry.us.description: Two minutes after Scandinavian Airlines Flight 751 leaves Stockholm in 1991, smoke filters through the cabin and both engines fail, one erupting into flames. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-28

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday - Dead Tired
circlecountry.us.description: In the worst U.S. crash in more than seven years, a Buffalo-bound flight stalls and plummets into a suburban home in 2009. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-29

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Ditching on the Hudson
circlecountry.us.description: Shortly after take-off, US Airways Flight 1549 encounters a bird strike and lands on the Hudson River. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-14

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Mid-Air Landing
circlecountry.us.description: Investigation into the 2009 crash of Turkish Airlines Flight 195; just before landing in Amsterdam, the plane mysteriously fell from the sky, killing nine people. (Documentary, Aviation, History, Science, Science fiction) - 2011-02-28

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Disaster Runway
circlecountry.us.description: On July 17, 2007, TAM Airlines Flight 3054 slides off runway 35L at Congonhas Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, and crashes at high speed into a warehouse adjacent to a petrol station killing nearly 200 people. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-08-12

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday - The Plane That Flew Too High
circlecountry.us.description: West Caribbean Airways Flight 708 crashes down killing 160 people in 2005, ultimately leading to the bankruptcy of the troubled airline. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-08-19

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday - Split Decision
circlecountry.us.description: Arrow Air Flight 1285 with 248 American soldiers on board crashes seconds after refueling in Newfoundland. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-08-26

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Break Up Over Texas
circlecountry.us.description: Near the end of its flight, Continental Express Flight 2574 suffers wing damage and goes into a dive falling out of the sky. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-12-29

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Mayday Munich
circlecountry.us.description: A plane with members of the Manchester United football team crashes while heading home from Yugoslavia, killing 23 aboard. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-12-29

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Turning Point
circlecountry.us.description: A Northwest Airlines flight cruises above the Bering Sea before problems develop and pilots must make an emergency landing in Anchorage. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-12-29

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Bad Attitude
circlecountry.us.description: Korean Air Cargo Flight 8509 crashes shortly after take off from London Stansted Airport on December 22, 1999. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-01-20

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Hiding in Plane Sight
circlecountry.us.description: In 1978, PSA Flight 182 collides with a Cessna and crashes into a San Diego residential area killing people on both planes and seven people on the ground. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-01-27

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Under Pressure
circlecountry.us.description: On July 11, 1991, the crew of Nigeria Airways Flight 2120 unsuccessfully tries to return to the airport after a burst tire creates an in-flight fire which causes 247 Nigerian pilgrims and 14 crew to perish. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-02-03

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - I'm the Problem
circlecountry.us.description: Moments before Pacific Southwest Flight 1771 crashes on a cattle ranch in California, gunshots are heard in the cabin. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-02-10

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday - Nowhere to Land
circlecountry.us.description: Pilots of TACA Flight 110 make a remarkable landing on a narrow levee, but investigators must find out why the engines in a brand-new plane failed. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-03-09

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - The Invisible Plane
circlecountry.us.description: SAS Flight 686 takes off from Milan's Linate Airport and moments later collides with a Cessna on the runway. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-03-23

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Impossible Landing
circlecountry.us.description: A shocking look at the fate of United Airlines Flight 232 which crashed into Sioux City's runway in 1989 causing a subsequent explosion that left 111 people dead. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-04-13

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Hanging by a Thread
circlecountry.us.description: Aloha Airlines Flight 243 loses part of its roof of the front fuselage before landing safely at Kahului, Maui. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-09-14

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday - Attack Over Baghdad
circlecountry.us.description: The crew of DHL Flight OO-LL must land the plane using only the engines to control the craft when a left wing explodes causing the plane to lose hydraulic pressure. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-09-21

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Out of Control
circlecountry.us.description: JAL Flight 123's steering system stops working 12 minutes after takeoff, causing the plane to crash into the side of a mountain and kill 520 people in 1985. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-09-28

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Suicide Attack
circlecountry.us.description: A FedEx flight out of Memphis descended into chaos when a surprise attack by a disgruntled employee threatened the lives of all on board. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-05

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Bomb on Board
circlecountry.us.description: On December 11, 1994, a terrorist bomb explodes on Philippine Airlines Flight 434, yet only one passenger dies. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-12

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Mistaken Identity
circlecountry.us.description: A high-tech American gunship stationed in the Persian Gulf shoots down Iran Air Flight 655 carrying 290 people when its systems confuse it with an Iranian fighter. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-19

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Helicopter Down
circlecountry.us.description: In 1995, a chopper carrying 18 people to a North Sea oil platform crashes; miraculously, everyone onboard survived in a life raft. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-26

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Death and Denial
circlecountry.us.description: EgyptAir Flight 990 suddenly crashed into the sea, killing all 217 people aboard and causing controversy over whether it was intentional or a mechanical malfunction. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-02

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Kid in the Cockpit
circlecountry.us.description: A Russian pilot allowed his teenage son to take control of Aeroflot Flight 593, setting in motion a chain of events that caused the deaths of 70 people. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-09

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Impact on the Rails
circlecountry.us.description: With its conductors sound asleep, a freight train fails to stop and collides with an oncoming train, resulting in tragedy. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-16

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Express Samina
circlecountry.us.description: A Greek ferry, the Express Samina, is pushed off course by strong waves and crashes into a rock formation causing eighty passengers to lose their lives in the freezing water as they wait for rescue. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-23

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Unstoppable Train
circlecountry.us.description: A freight train carrying an excess of cargo loses its brakes while descending a mountain causing it to gain speed and derail into a neighborhood killing several people. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-30

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - African Hijack
circlecountry.us.description: When three hijackers ordered an Ethiopian plane to fly to Australia, the pilot tricked them by flying south along the African coast, with deadly consequences. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-12-07

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday - Desperate Escape
circlecountry.us.description: In August 2005, Air France Flight 358 skidded off the runway in Toronto, trapping more than 300 passengers on the plane. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-05

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - All Engines Failed
circlecountry.us.description: British Airways Flight 9 falls toward the ocean when all four engines mysteriously fail, and then restart. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-06

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Fiery Landing
circlecountry.us.description: When fire erupted aboard Air Canada Flight 797, the pilot made an emergency landing; flames engulfed the plane when the doors opened, killing half of the passengers. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-06

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Missed Approach
circlecountry.us.description: Korean Airlines Flight 801 overshoots a runway during the final approach for a night landing and crashes into a hillside on Aug. 6, 1997. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-08

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Mystery Crashes
circlecountry.us.description: Mystery surrounds two 737 crashes until USAir Flight 427's near miss gives investigators the information to solve the case. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-27

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Panic Over the Pacific
circlecountry.us.description: A stalled engine causes China Airlines Flight 006 to go into a deadly spin before crew members were able to regain control. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-09-10

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Out of Sight
circlecountry.us.description: A 1986 midair crash between Aeroméxico Flight 498 and Piper Archer N4891F near Los Angeles results in the creation of a collision-avoidance system. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-09-10

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Inbound
circlecountry.us.description: U.S. Secretary of Commerce Ron Brown and 34 others are killed in 1996 when their Air Force 737 crashes on a mountain in Croatia. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-09-17

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Deadly Disorientation
circlecountry.us.description: Flash Airlines Flight 604 crashes into the Red Sea shortly after take-off, killing all 148 people on board.

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Unconscious Pilot
circlecountry.us.description: The worst crash in Greek aviation history occurs in 2005 when all 121 people on board Helios Airways Flight 522 lose consciousness.

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Invisible Killer
circlecountry.us.description: During a storm, a strong gale slams Delta Air Lines Flight 191 to the ground killing most people on board.

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Miracle Flight
circlecountry.us.description: A pilot heads for a decommissioned air force base, not knowing it is hosting a weekend family event, when the passenger jet he is flying unexpectedly runs out of fuel.

circlecountry.us.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Behind Closed Doors (American Airlines Flight 96 and Turkish Airlines Flight 981)
circlecountry.us.description: A design fault leads to an explosion on a DC-10 and two years later the same design fault causes another tragedy.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: The Golden Life

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E10 The Fight Ted and Barney pick a fight with a bunch of guys to improve their friends' perceptions of them.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E11 Little Minnesota Ted goes out of his way to keep his sister out of trouble when she comes to visit; Marshall introduces Robin to a Minnesota-themed bar.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E12 Benefits Robin and Ted discover they get along better as roommates if they become friends with benefits; reality stars taunt Marshall from the pages of his magazine.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E13 Three Days of Snow Lily and Marshall try to continue their airport reunion tradition; Barney and Ted offer to keep MacLaren's open during a blizzard so they can meet up with some college girls.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E14 The Possimpible Robin, desperate to find a job before she is deported, agrees to let Barney produce a video resume for her.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E15 The Stinsons The gang thinks that Barney must have a secret girlfriend after noticing his bizarre behavior.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E16 Sorry, Bro Marshall and Lily are less than thrilled when they hear that Ted's college girlfriend (Laura Prepon) has moved to New York.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E17 The Front Porch Ted learns that Lily not only planted another woman's earring in his bed for Karen to find, but she also meddled in some of his other relationships.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E18 Old King Clancy Barney and Marshall conspire to keep Ted in the dark when a client cancels plans to build its new headquarters using Ted's design.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E19 Murtaugh Barney tries to prove Ted wrong by completing every task on Ted's list of things he thinks the gang is too old to do.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: How I Met Your Mother
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S04 E20 Mosbius Designs When Ted loses his job, he decides to start his own architectural firm.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E15 Smell the Umbrella Stand Charlie tries to distract Alan from an upcoming medical procedure by planning a trip to Las Vegas.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E16 Can You Eat Human Flesh With Wooden Teeth? Judith leaves Jake with Alan and Charlie while she spends a week in Hawaii, and the guys find that caring for Jake on a daily basis is much different from weekend visits.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E17 Woo-Hoo, A Hernia-Exam! Charlie eschews Alan's medical advice in favor of a visit to his pretty female doctor after he injures his back during sex.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E18 It Was Mame, Mom When a gay ad executive invites Charlie to a cocktail party, Charlie makes Alan go with him, as his gay partner.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E19 A Low, Guttural Tongue-Flapping Noise Alan asks one of Charlie's beautiful ex-girlfriends (Jeri Ryan) on a date, but while they are out he is tormented by thoughts of her with Charlie.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E20 I Always Wanted a Shaved Monkey When Charlie and Alan take their personal frustrations out on each other, Rose tries to help the brothers sort out their feelings.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E21 A Sympathetic Crotch to Cry On When Evelyn reads in the obituaries that her second husband, Harry, has died, she attends the funeral with Alan, then is furious to learn that Alan had kept in touch with Harry after the divorce.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E22 That Old Hose Bag Is My Mother After taking a loan from Evelyn, Alan is guilted into double-dating with her, her new romantic interest and his daughter.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E23 Squab, Squab, Squab, Squab, Squab Alan is reluctant to leave Jake with Evelyn for a sleepover visit until he finds himself partying with Charlie and a busload of beautiful female volleyball players.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S02 E24 Does This Smell Funny to You? Charlie unknowingly sleeps with an elderly man's (Orson Bean) hot trophy wife.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E01 Weekend in Bangkok With Two Olympic Gymnasts After Alan falls off the roof, Charlie volunteers to watch Jake for the weekend.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E02 Principal Gallagher's Lesbian Lover Alan must see the school principal over a picture Jake drew of a schoolmate and calls Charlie to watch over the boy.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E03 Carpet Burns and a Bite Mark Charlie organizes an intervention to keep Alan from reuniting with Judith.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E04 Your Dismissive Attitude Toward Boobs Berta moves into Charlie's house for a few days and plays one brother against the other.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E05 We Called It Mr. Pinky Charlie responds inappropriately to a woman's declaration of love, and Rose says his inability to have a long-lasting relationship is due to unresolved issues with his mother.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E06 Hi, Mr. Horned One Charlie likes dating Isabella (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), a wild, sexually uninhibited woman, until she threatens to put a curse on his manhood.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E07 Sleep Tight, Puddin' Pop Rose's father (Martin Sheen) confronts Charlie about his intentions toward Rose.

eentertainmentwest.us.title: Two and a Half Men
eentertainmentwest.us.description: S03 E08 That Voodoo That I Do Do Charlie cons Jake into taking ballet lessons in order to get close to the teacher.

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist. (Historical drama) - 1995

filmriseaction.us.title: Guns of Redemption
filmriseaction.us.description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel. (Western, Action) - 2025

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. (Western) - 2023

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz
filmriseaction.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. (Drama) - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E01 The Apple Doesn't Fall A new police officer, who has narcolepsy, replaces Mark Mylow; Martin treats a girl who's been taking her mother's diet pills.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E02 Movement Unhappy with his lot in life, Bert Large abandons his plumbing business to start his own restaurant, but the eatery's opening is followed immediately by several cases of food poisoning.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E04 The Admirer Louisa Glasson finds out she has a rival for Doc Martin's affections; Martin accidentally runs over a dog.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E05 The Holly Bears a Prickle Louisa ends her relationship with Martin, but when she needs him to treat her injured friend, he gets a chance to redeem himself.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E06 Nowt So Queer Portwenn is buzzing with news; Bert's restaurant is in trouble, so his son decides to take action to save the business.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E07 Happily Ever After Martin needs to find a replacement vicar just three hours before the wedding; bridesmaid Isobel goes into labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E01 Better the Devil Martin prepares to leave Portwenn when his relationship with Louisa fails; Martin's medical school girlfriend arrives.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E02 Uneasy Lies the Head Martin is unsure what to do when he hears Louisa's news, but Louisa does not want him involved; Louisa's new headmaster is exhibiting erratic behavior.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E03 Perish Together as Fools Louisa has a medical scare and goes to Martin for reassurance; Joe Penhale's brother Sam comes to town; Martin learns the surgery needs some updating.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E04 Driving Mr. McLynn Martin urges Louisa to slow down after he catches her moving furniture; Martin refuses a handicapped parking tag for an elderly couple when the man won't prove he is disabled.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E05 The Departed The widow of one of Doc's patients believes her husband is trying to communicate from the grave; one of Louisa's students falls ill on a class trip.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E06 Midwife Crisis Doc clashes with the new district midwife over natural methods; Bert becomes enamored with a new restaurant employee.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E07 Do Not Disturb Pauline finds out Doc is leaving; Bert organizes a baby shower for Louisa; Doc and Edith go to a conference.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E08 The Wrong Goodbye Bert has another money-making scheme go wrong on Doc's last day in Portwenn, causing Louisa to go into premature labor.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother. (Romantic comedy) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him. (Drama) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mysteria
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Aleister Bain (Robert Miano), a whiskey-soaked and washed-up Hollywood screenwriter, desperately struggles to finish a script. (Mystery) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1994

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Eye See You
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisetruecrime.us.title: World's Most Evil Killers
filmrisetruecrime.us.description: World's Most Evil Killers delves straight into the stories of the world's most prolific killers. Each episode focuses on one notorious killer and features first-hand accounts of their behavior; such killers range from Fred and Rose West, Ed Gein, the Clown Killer, to the Milwaukee Cannibal. Accounts are also given by detectives who ran the cases, journalists who reported on them, relatives, experts on analysis, and sometimes even survivors. (Documentary, Crime) - 2017-05-25

justicecentral.us.description: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives. retroplex.us.title: The Westward Trail
retroplex.us.description: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Black Hills
retroplex.us.description: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Nowhere to Hide

When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S37 E11 Belmont Victorian: Grinding Out the Details Converting a glass-paneled storm door into a custom mudroom-porch window; selecting Victorian-inspired paint colors for the main living areas; white cedar shingles for the porch pier; laying marble tile in the master bath walk-in shower.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S37 E12 Belmont Victorian: This Old Tree House Creating an arched feature for the new gable above the front porch stairs that mimics the arch in the side gable of the house; finishing the front porch; a custom floorcloth for the kitchen; building the porch railings; a tree house for the kids.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S37 E13 Belmont Victorian: What's Old Is New Again Norm builds a ladder for the tree house while Tommy lays the decking and Kevin installs balusters; prepping 120-year-old shingles for a fresh coat of paint; Tommy installs a new storm window; custom molding for the front entryway wainscoting.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S37 E14 Belmont Victorian: Inside-Out Restoration Roger replants trees and shrubs; landscape designer Jennifer Nawada finishes the backyard; a craftsman carves two newel posts to match the original on the main staircase; installing the kitchen cabinets; marble countertop is installed.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S37 E15 Belmont Victorian: The Final Countdown Kitchen countertop installation; building a divider between the eating area and the mudroom to provide storage; changes are made to the mechanical systems; a special primer is applied to a kitchen wall for messages and notes; window treatments.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S37 E16 Belmont Victorian: Good-bye, Tired Old House Roger finishes the landscape; Norm on the design details of the front porch; Kevin admires the front entry; Tommy shows the homeowners disguised PVC floor registers; Richard installs the storm windows; Kevin recaps the treehouse and mudroom.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

tntwest.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
tntwest.us.description: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Comedy) - 1966-12-18

tntwest.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tntwest.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Fantasy) - 1974-12-10

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: The team head to Birmingham for one of the highlights of the horticultural calendar: the annual Gardeners' World Live event.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants out annuals in the jewel garden, adds agapanthus to the mound and finds a new home for his pelargoniums. Adam Frost visits an innovative kitchen garden at the Spurs training centre in North London, which provides fresh produce for its players, coaches and staff. In Wiltshire, Carol Klein's at a glorious early summer garden which employs clever use of curves, circles and spheres in its evergreen planting.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants out sweetcorn, checks in on his container veg and creates a display with fuchsias. Nick Bailey visits a nurserywoman and gardener in Cheshire who uses perennials as the stars of the garden to provide interest throughout the year. With only a few weeks to go, Sue Kent shares an update on the progress of her first ever show garden, destined for the Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival. And there's a gardener in Somerset who couldn't live without roses in her garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Gardeners' World comes from the RHS Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival. Adam Frost, Carol Klein and Joe Swift reveal the highlights of the show gardens, meet the designers and growers and share the season's must have flowers and plants on display.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty is back at Longmeadow, getting stuck into some seasonal jobs. Arit Anderson and Nick Bailey present highlights from RHS Flower Show Tatton Park, and Carol Klein visits a garden in Somerset.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty shows how to deal with drought, takes fuchsia cuttings and demonstrates how to summer prune fruit trees. There's also a catch-up with three sisters in Dorset who developed a love of gardening during lockdown, this time, they plant up two beds, one for sun and one for shade.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.
