outlaw.us.title: Wild Rovers
outlaw.us.description: Tired of his job at a ranch owned by Walter Buckman (Karl Malden), Frank Post (Ryan O'Neal) wants to pull a heist, and when his much older coworker, Ross Bodine (William Holden), sees nothing better on the horizon, the cowboys agree to team up for the crime. After filling their pockets with loot from a local bank, Frank and Ross ride toward what they hope is freedom. But the younger Buckmans, Paul (Joe Don Baker) and John (Tom Skerritt), pursue them over the rough land of the Southwest. (Western) - 1971

outlaw.us.title: The Dawn Rider
outlaw.us.description: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

outlaw.us.title: Tension at Table Rock
outlaw.us.description: When locals are wrongfully led to believe that Wes Tancred murdered a gunslinger in cold blood, they exile the innocent man. Tancred sets off in search of a new start and arrives in the dusty hamlet of Table Rock -- only to find his reputation has preceded him. To avoid trouble, Tancred uses an assumed name. But, when Sheriff Fred Miller talks of trouble at the hands of a violent gang, Tancred agrees to be deputized, and struggles for his shot at redemption. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: Cahill, United States Marshal
outlaw.us.description: A U.S. marshal (John Wayne) neglects his two sons and finds them mixed up with an outlaw (George Kennedy) in a bank robbery. (Western) - 1973

outlaw.us.title: Chisum
outlaw.us.description: Kind-hearted, fatherly John Chisum (John Wayne) owns a large ranch in Lincoln County, New Mexico, in the 1870s. With the help of his faithful sidekick, Pepper (Ben Johnson), and a hot-headed young ranch hand nicknamed Billy the Kid (Geoffrey Deuel), Chisum does battle with underhanded land developer Lawrence Murphy (Forrest Tucker). Having bought up most of the nearby town and appointed his own corrupt sheriff (Bruce Cabot), Murphy now has his eye on Chisum's ranch. (Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: Cimarron
outlaw.us.description: After Sabra (Maria Schell) marries cowboy Yancey Cravat (Glenn Ford) against her parents' wishes, the newlyweds travel to Oklahoma to participate in a land rush for territory taken from the Indians. Settling down in their new community, Yancey becomes locally prominent as the editor of the town newspaper. When he turns down an offer to run for governor because his oil-money backers would demand more property from the Indians, Sabra's disapproval drives Yancey to leave. (Western) - 1960

outlaw.us.title: Ride the High Country
outlaw.us.description: Reduced to transporting gold from a distant mine to a small-town bank, retired lawman Steve Judd (Joel McCrea) recruits friend Gil Westrum (Randolph Scott), who has been performing in a traveling carnival. Unknown to Steve, the restless Gil and a young drifter intend to steal the next gold transport. On the way, the men help Elsa Knudsen (Mariette Hartley) to break free from her zealot father and join her fiancé at the mine, not realizing the consequences that await them all. (Western) - 1962

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - The Trail Gang
outlaw.us.description: An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff. (Drama, Western) - 1960-11-26

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - The Savage
outlaw.us.description: Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white. (Drama, Western) - 1960-12-03

outlaw.us.title: How the West Was Won - The Hearing
outlaw.us.description: As Luke's hearing commences, Frank Grayson presents evidence that hurts his case; Doreen frames Josh for assault. (Western, History, Adventure, Drama) - 1978-05-14

outtvproud.us.title: Sometimes They Come Back... Again
outtvproud.us.description: For years, Jon Porter (Michael Gross) has been repressing memories of how his older sister was murdered -- and how he electrocuted her three assailants to death. Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed. (Horror) - 1996

outtvproud.us.title: She's Back
outtvproud.us.description: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge. (Comedy) - 1988

outtvproud.us.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
outtvproud.us.description: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Expecting
outtvproud.us.description: Lizzie's best friend, Andie, becomes pregnant and offers to give the baby to her. Lizzie's husband, Peter, reluctantly goes along with being the child's father, and Andie moves into the guest room for the remainder of the pregnancy. (Comedy drama) - 2013

outtvproud.us.title: True Crime
outtvproud.us.description: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her. (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery, Horror) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: 3 Generations
outtvproud.us.description: Hoping to get support from his mother (Naomi Watts) and grandmother (Susan Sarandon), a New York teen (Elle Fanning) prepares to transition from female to male. (Comedy drama, LGBTQ) - 2015

outtvproud.us.title: Georgia Rule
outtvproud.us.description: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside. (Drama) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Fierce People
outtvproud.us.description: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

outtvproud.us.title: 3 Generations
outtvproud.us.description: Hoping to get support from his mother (Naomi Watts) and grandmother (Susan Sarandon), a New York teen (Elle Fanning) prepares to transition from female to male. (Comedy drama, LGBTQ) - 2015

outtvproud.us.title: Laggies
outtvproud.us.description: When 28-year-old Megan attends her 10-year high-school reunion, she realizes that very little in her life has changed. An unexpected marriage proposal from her boyfriend sparks panic in Megan, causing her to wander off into the night. She meets 16-year-old Annika and proceeds to get drunk. Deciding she needs a break from her unfulfilling life, she tells her boyfriend she's going to a seminar but hangs with Annika. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2014

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

shadesofblack.us.title: Chaos
shadesofblack.us.description: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property 2
shadesofblack.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: Who's Your Caddy?
shadesofblack.us.description: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life. (Comedy) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: More Money, More Family
shadesofblack.us.description: Two cousins pretend they won the lottery to reunite their fractured family. (Comedy) - 2015

shadesofblack.us.title: Eve's Bayou
shadesofblack.us.description: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan). (Drama) - 1997

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Mix
shadesofblack.us.description: Mobster Frank (Chazz Palminteri) hires hip DJ Darrell (Usher) to man the turntables at a party for his gorgeous daughter, Dolly (Emmanuelle Chriqui). At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him. (Comedy drama) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: Judgment Night
shadesofblack.us.description: New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. At the last minute, they are joined by John (Stephen Dorff), Frank's brother. Stuck in gridlock traffic, the guys take a shortcut that gets them lost. thestandupchannel.us.title: Paul Rodriguez: The Here and Wow

thestandupchannel.us.title: Louis Anderson: Big Baby Boomer
thestandupchannel.us.description: Veteran funny man Louie Anderson returns to the stage in this hilarious one hour stand-up comedy special; Louie takes an unconventional and jovial look at his bad habits, pesky family members, and aging body.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Josh Blue: Delete
thestandupchannel.us.description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Lavell Crawford: I Could Eat - Part 1
thestandupchannel.us.description: Lavell Crawford is back and here to contemplate how "My 600 Pound Life" could go for 15 seasons and he was still underweight, the kind of racist you have to be to not take a free holiday, and explosive consequences in a Taco Bell bathroom.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Lavell Crawford I Could Eat Part 2
thestandupchannel.us.description: Meat's on the menu with Lavell Crawford keeping Burger King humble to their have it your way slogan, godless vegetarians, and why the best chicken is from a house of God.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs his most popular characters, including Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, and Bubba J, while discussing topics such as Hollywood, politics and romance.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
thestandupchannel.us.description: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry

thestandupchannel.us.title: D.L. Hughley: Clear
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic performs in San Francisco, discussing current affairs and nosy neighbors at the Regency Theater.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

thestandupchannel.us.title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness
thestandupchannel.us.description: From growing up in Northern Virginia to feeling unsafe in his new home in New York, Andrew's charming world view shines through in stories about dating, workplace mishaps and first loves.

travel.us.title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
travel.us.description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen. (Paid Program, Health)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Alone In The Arctic, Space Shuttle Macgyver and Angelic Organ
travel.us.description: Don Wildman examines a pocket calendar that belonged to a woman stranded in the Arctic, a space shuttle that was at the center of a harrowing ordeal more than 200 miles above Earth and a musical instrument which produced heavenly sounds. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Transatlantic Zeppelin, Potato Pool and The Lost Inca City
travel.us.description: Don Wildman examines an engineer's daring mission to save a high-flying Zeppelin, a pint-sized prodigy's plan to play pool and an explorer's lifelong quest to uncover an ancient lost Inca city. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Miss Unsinkable, Crop Circles and Detective Goodwin
travel.us.description: A Titanic survivor plagued by disaster; the cause of mysterious crop circles in England; the case that created the first NYPD female detective. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Project Vortex, Diamond Heist and Tinseltown, NJ
travel.us.description: Investigating a scientist's attempt to document the life cycle of a tornado; a record-breaking $100 million heist; a pioneering filmmaker who went head-to-head against Thomas Edison. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Mystery Of Silence, Fearless Flyer and Fifty Stars
travel.us.description: Don Wildman examines a printing press connected to a Founding Father's secret identity, a model plane with the propeller in the back flown by a record-setting aviatrix and an American flag designed by a high school kid. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Eisenhower's Crazy Convoy, Criminal Measures and Canyon Adventure
travel.us.description: Don Wildman investigates a president's cross-country road trip, a detective's plan to cut down on crime and an explorers dangerous quest to be the first to uncover the secrets of the Grand Canyon. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Dewey Defeats Truman, the Real Jekyll and Hyde and Sunken Steamship Treasure
travel.us.description: Don Wildman examines how an iconic headline came to be, the real-life inspiration for a literary villain and the search for millions of dollars of sunken treasure. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Winnie The Bear, Frozen Miracle and Whiskey Galore
travel.us.description: Don Wildman examines a stuffed bear that inspired one of the greatest children's books of all time, a fireman's pike used in an icy rescue mission and a bottle of whiskey that was once at the center of an illegal escapade. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Undercover Informant, the Black Beetle and Unexpected Artist
travel.us.description: Don Wildman examines the insider who took down Al Capone, a jet engine that was used in a daring railroad experiment and a portrait painted by a woman who overcame insurmountable odds to become a world-renowned artist. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Antis The Radar Dog, Bringing Up The Baby and The Art Of Murder
travel.us.description: Don Wildman investigates a dog with a sixth sense for danger, the harrowing tale of a drill rescue and a magazine detailing the murder of a famous model. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Dorothy Of Dakota, Crop Circles Of the Deep and Tunnel Of Love
travel.us.description: Don Wildman investigates a girl who went over the rainbow, a deep-sea design with mysterious origins and a man who dug his way into a woman's heart. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - How To Sell The Eiffel Tower, Killer Lake and Cinderella Girl
travel.us.description: Don Wildman investigates a legendary scam artist, an African lake with a hidden danger and a young girl who celebrated her birthday at the White House. (Travel, Documentary)

travel.us.title: Mysteries of the Unknown - Fleeing the Nazis, Atlantis Arises, Bombing of New Mexico
travel.us.description: A spy with a wooden leg barely escapes Nazi-occupied France with her life; mysterious stones may be from the ruins of the lost city of Atlantis; twisted shrapnel tells of a near-miss military accident in New Mexico. (Travel)

travel.us.title: Mysteries of the Unknown - Oak Island Treasure, Origin of the Nobel Prize, Oregon Trail Coffin
travel.us.description: A ghostly pirate may be protecting his buried treasure on a remote island; a coffin carries a whiskey-preserved body across the Oregon Trail; the inventor of dynamite writes a will that changes the world forever. (Travel)

travel.us.title: Mysteries of the Unknown - Chaplin Grave Robbery, Ghost Will, Roller Skate Rivalry
travel.us.description: Grave robbers steal the corpse of an international movie star; a dispute over a will is resolved when a ghost reveals the existence of a second will; the inventor of roller skates loses himself in legal battles over his creation. (Travel)

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - The Celts and the Classical World
truehistory.us.description: Studying the earliest written records of the Celts from Italy, Greece and Spain, dating as far back as the sixth century B.C.; scholarly theories about the Celts' migration throughout Europe; the foundation of humanity's understanding of the Celts. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Art and Artifacts
truehistory.us.description: How archeological studies of Celtic artifacts have woven a rich tapestry of their millennia-old society; learning about war trumpets, gold necklaces and other recovered objects from around Europe; building an image of this ever-adapting culture. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Languages in the Ancient World
truehistory.us.description: The discovery of Celtic inscriptions on Spain's western coast; the possibility of a common language along maritime trade routes; revolutionizing studies of Celtic origins and migration; the long-standing theory of Central European Celtic origins. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Caesar and the Gauls
truehistory.us.description: How several centuries of combat against Celtic-controlled Gaul made northern Italy and southern France a dangerous place for the Romans; Julius Caesar's wars against the Gauls; famous figures of world history and their encounters with the Gauls. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Religion and the Druids
truehistory.us.description: Celtic religious beliefs in divination, reincarnation and human sacrifice; discovering the ancient religious figures known as druids, who served as holy men, soothsayers, and even lawyers; an insight into the Celtic version of the sacred. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Britain and Roman Britain
truehistory.us.description: The theory of trade-based migration to explain the arrival of the Celts' influence in Britain before the arrival of the Romans; the struggle between the Celts and the Romans over Britain; untangling a web of history on the island. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celts and Picts in Scotland
truehistory.us.description: Life in Scotland during the time of a Romanized southern Britain; the warring tribes of Picts that ruled North Britain; highlights that include the ancient Pictish tongue and the truth about William "Braveheart" Wallace. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - A Meeting of Two Worlds
truehistory.us.description: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire
truehistory.us.description: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - The Interwar Period
truehistory.us.description: American interest in the Middle East between the wars; revealing one's focus shifting in the 1930s to American interest in Saudi Arabian oil; the increasing activism of American Zionism in response to Hitler's persecution of German Jews. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - U.S. & the Middle East During World War II
truehistory.us.description: United States' entry into World War II alters Americans' conception of the Middle East; the Middle East's geopolitical orientation is now seen as vital to American security. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Creation Stories and Why They Matter
truehistory.us.description: Considering the nature of creation stories. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
truehistory.us.description: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish
truehistory.us.description: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-15

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
truehistory.us.description: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-15

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion
truehistory.us.description: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
truehistory.us.description: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Arab Invasion of North Africa - 639
truehistory.us.description: The seventh-century Arab invasion of North Africa brings profound change to the entire region; the Arab armies of the newly created Islamic empire try to conquer the territories of Egypt and others; the lasting Arabization and Islamization. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Umayyad Caliphate in Damascus - 661
truehistory.us.description: The establishment of the Umayyad Caliphate's capital in Damascus is a key event in early Muslim history; the Umayyads' achievements; locating the empire's capital away from the Arabian Peninsula; the shift from an Islamic empire to imperial power. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
truehistory.us.description: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
truehistory.us.description: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon
truehistory.us.description: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi
truehistory.us.description: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything. (History) - 2022-07-15

unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E05 Acts of God Examining various events that are said to have been directed by the hand of the Almighty, such as the Great Flood, the Plagues of Egypt, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Moses parting the Red Sea.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E07 Mysterious Tombs Throughout history, humans have buried their dead in caves or chambers, in pyramids or in some form of a tomb; ancient tombs were visual memorials for the dead; in China, a vast necropolis was constructed as a way to connect to the afterlife.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E16 Amazing Animal Abilities A dog that can detect cancer faster than doctors can do it by using sophisticated equipment; a horse that can read minds; birds that can sense disaster days before it happens.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E15 Vampires and Werewolves Dracula, Lycaon of Arcadia, the Beast of Gévaudan; these are the names of grotesque monsters who have reared their terrifying heads throughout history, unearthly creatures that thrived on human blood and flesh.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E14 Mysterious Stones A miraculous meteorite falling from the heavens and a chunk of sandstone considered so sacred that wars have been fought to protect it; throughout history, many have insisted that simple stones can do everything from choosing a king to causing death.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E04 Secrets of Abandoned Places From the ancient Babylonians to modern-day urban explorers, mankind has always been fascinated by abandoned places; discovering the allure that draws people to post-apocalyptic landscapes.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E06 Serial Killer Creatures The animal kingdom is full of deadly predators, and some of them attack in extraordinary and inexplicable ways; some animals strike back at humans for reasons beyond normal defense and hunger.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park on the Missouri River while camping with her family. Several months passed with no leads, then an FBI agent took a particular interest in the case. Using a new technique known as criminal profiling, he predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction. When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1996, a group of political extremists twice robbed a bank in Spokane, Washington, using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers, part of a shadowy organization called the Phineas Priesthood, might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement. After the suspects were identified, the FBI was faced with the task of safely arresting a group of terrorists with a deadly agenda.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent. The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts. When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1988, new light was shed on the mysterious death of a South Carolina farmer when a criminal confessed that two prominent community members hired him to commit murder. Local police and FBI agents arrested a wealthy businessman and later learned that, even behind bars, he commanded the power to corrupt and kill. Using prison informants, agents had to prevent him from murdering again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1993, a robber surprised unsuspecting customers by dropping through the roof of a California bank. When police arrived, he escaped from the roof in a hail of bullets. A tip from a local resident led police and FBI agents to the perpetrator. They would soon learn that he had masterminded a local kidnapping, and held the fate of an innocent woman in his hands.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Amid the cocaine wars of early 1980's Miami, three dead bodies led a multi-agency tactical squad to suspect that a group of cops might be involved in illegal drug busts. Investigating rumors of corruption, the squad uncovered a ring of patrolmen who were making millions by ripping off smuggled cocaine. The investigators set out to prove that even with the advantages wealth and the protection of a police badge, nobody is above the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A man is found suffocated in his Pennsylvania home, his checkbook, credit cards and vehicle appear to have been stolen. Fingerprints from the victim identify a recent escapee from a minimum-security prison, as well as his girlfriend. Investigators flag the dead man's credit cards, and are alerted when one is used in North Dakota. The FBI is called in and joins another task force already assembled because of a suspected kidnapping.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Wisconsin, a varsity athlete is blindfolded, gagged, and shoved into a van by four gunmen. The kidnappers contact the victim's family and demand $30,000, but offer no instructions on how to transfer the money. The victim's family contacts the police. The boy's captors tell his family they have shot him, and will kill him if they do not receive their money. At an agreed upon drop site, FBI agents approach the captor's vehicle, only to watch them flee and quickly be followed by authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A New Jersey State Trooper is shot to death on the side of Interstate 80 near the Pennsylvania border. Witnesses to the shooting identify the shooter's car. Police issue an APB, and locate the vehicle hours later. Fingerprinting of the vehicle points to a fugitive wanted on bank robbery charges. Authorities who inspect the fugitive's home find some incriminating evidence including a box of bullets linked to the Trooper's murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1991, the Safe Streets Task Force, a joint FBI / Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Department organization, begins conducting an investigation into the violent activities of a local gang called the K Street Crew. Gang members are suspected of involvement in several area homicides. The FBI approaches several witnesses, hoping to convince them to testify against the gang members. Seven potential witnesses are murdered during the course of the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 2000, two gunmen rob a Seattle, WA bank, and flee on foot as officers chase them. One of the gunmen is killed in a firefight with police, the other escapes after assaulting a family and using their home to hide. The family helps FBI agents identify the man, who is suspected of several other robberies. Seattle SWAT teams, working with the FBI, search the home of the assailant's mother, and find ammunition matching that used at the bank robbery.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A California bank manager panics and calls in the FBI after the door to his vault refuses to open. Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: An Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed after pulling over a van for a traffic violation. Officers apprehend the shooter, after a car chase and shootout. ATF is alerted when officers find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Further testing of the weapons reveals one was used in a murder several months earlier. ATF traces some of the firearms to purchases made by another man from and arms dealer. They also match silencer marks from the weapons to a third man previously arrested for stealing a flatbed truck.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Washington DC professor is shot and killed as she tries to get into her car. The killer leaves the body in the parking lot and drives away in her vehicle. A week later, a man robs a bank, and security cameras capture the same vehicle as the getaway car. The FBI believes they are dealing with the same man. Days later, the same vehicle is involved in a shootout with police, but eventually would elude them. Eventually, the vehicle is found, the interior covered with red dye from the stolen bank packs.

673500.title: Paula
673500.description: After her second miscarriage, Paula Rogers (Loretta Young) learns she is sterile. On the way to a reception for her professor husband, John (Kent Smith), a distraught Paula accidentally hits an orphan (Tommy Rettig) with her car. Thinking Paula is drunk, farmer Raymond Bascom (Will Wright) takes the boy to the hospital. Unwilling to confess her role in the hit-and-run for fear of derailing John's career, Paula volunteers at the hospital and helps Davey recover without admitting her guilt.

673500.title: What a Woman!
673500.description: An author (Willard Parker) and a literary agent (Rosalind Russell) become involved after selling film rights to his racy book.

673500.title: The Happy Time
673500.description: A large French-Canadian family suddenly expands when father Jacques (Charles Boyer) invites an out-of-work magician's assistant to be their live-in maid. At the same time, charming ladies' man Uncle Desmond (Louis Jourdan) comes back to town to replace a sales manager who has died, and subsequently begins a romance with the new maid. Jacques' son Bobby watches these interactions with confused curiosity as he makes the tough transition from boyhood to adolescence.

673500.title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
673500.description: During WW II, Lt. Rip Crandall and his inexperienced and motley crew get assigned to deliver an Australian observer to a Japanese-held island.

673500.title: You Were Never Lovelier
673500.description: Bob Davis (Fred Astaire), an American dancer in Buenos Aires, Argentina, finds himself desperate for work after losing all his money. He takes a gig at a wedding, hoping to impress the bride's father, Eduardo Acuña (Adolphe Menjou), a local club owner who has decreed that his daughters must marry in order of age. Eduardo eventually agrees to allow Bob to perform at his club, but only under the condition that he play suitor to his second-oldest daughter, the beautiful Maria (Rita Hayworth).

673500.title: A Raisin in the Sun
673500.description: Sidney Poitier stars in this iconic version of the famous play about a cash poor family who start to fray when they inherit a life insurance payout.
